title: 糖光折炼
description: 拉出闪亮的糖带，绕一只结，敲成碎片，再用热光把它炼回新的形状。
tech: Canvas 2D + original procedural Web Audio; local-only assets
mechanism: 在多色多宽糖雕上按住局部拉伸；绕结改变盘卷结构；敲碎后形成最多120糖片；热熔重建5–7条多宽渐变糖带，保持展示构图，反复组合。
audio: Original procedural score and operation tones; ArtSound first gesture unlock, true mute, mute-preserving reset, blur/pagehide pause, 12 voices / 26 nodes maximum.

selfCheck.limitations: Headless Chromium simulation, not physical handset or human listening.
